tasks.label: Docker: build and push JustPix image
tasks.command: IMAGE=ghcr.io/joshndroid/justpix; VERSION=$(python3 -c 'from app.version import __version__; print(__version__)'); docker build -t "$IMAGE:latest" -t "$IMAGE:$VERSION" . && docker push "$IMAGE:latest" && docker push "$IMAGE:$VERSION"
